# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-10T17:53Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-11T07:53Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 27 measured from open data, 11 follow a published figure, 51 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 39/100 (Unsettled) · 14 Alert · 43 Watch · 32 Normal Headline: The US–Iran war keeps Hormuz traffic about 65% below normal and Gulf energy at Alert; Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov; US October CPI ran hot; gold moves to Watch after a 9% three-month fall.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Hormuz traffic about 65% below pre-war levels (UKMTO, 10 Nov); US blockade continues; Trump said on 9 Nov he would hold off strikes. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, uk-energy-cap, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: Zaporizhzhia lost off-site power on 8 Nov, restored about 10h later; 162 drones overnight to 10 Nov; Abu Dhabi talks 10–11 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature +2.03°C on 4 Nov, a record for the date; CO₂ growth 3.36 ppm/yr. → alert: enso, global-temp, co2; watch: drought, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: ECDC counts 10,741 Ebola cases and 5,230 deaths in DR Congo to 5 Nov; new zone Yakoma borders CAR; cases in Kenya and Nigeria. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: RSF drone strike killed 9 in Blue Nile (reported 10 Nov); army advancing in West Kordofan; FEWS NET sees famine risk spreading in South Darfur. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread 152.9bp on 9 Nov, just above the 150bp Alert line; French 10-year near 4.70% on 10 Nov; protests continue. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US October CPI +0.4% m/m (10 Nov), a Fed rise in December now expected; BoE at 4% since 5 Nov; gilt 10-year 5.21% on 10 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Cholera & mosquito-borne [cholera-dengue] stable, AI-judged: DR Congo leads new cholera deaths globally, with 288 in the month to 27 Oct; insecurity limits access in the east - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable, AI-judged: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 10 Nov
## Changed in last 24h - Gold (fear gauge) [gold]: NORMAL→WATCH — Gold near $4,027 on 10 Nov, down 8.9% over three months, past the 8% fall that marks Watch (2026-11-10T17:53Z)
